reconciliation.create.name: optional

Decision.settlementAmount: positive exact decimal string in original Stellar asset units for allocate, null otherwise

Result.invoices: full invoice rows including original, exact minor amounts, linked invoicePayments and checks
Result.invoicePayments: full original rows and exact invoiceId/intentId related version IDs/checks
Result.payments: full original payment rows; succeeded collections counted once at payment-intent layer
Result.payouts: full original payout rows with original status/confirmation/approval/charges
Result.settlements: complete selected original Stellar movement + transaction/network evidence and checks
Result.events: full verified original webhook facts, never current native state solely by arrival
Result.allocations: every selected allocation/decision and exact checks
Result.totals: unit-separated {sourceScope,environment,currency,unit:'minor',role,values:{amount,count,...}} buckets; invoice stocks separate from collections/payouts; unknown date/amount stays unknown
Result.coverage: full source/capture/query/cursor/terminal completeness and exact selection

rowCommon.amounts: object each original monetary field→exact normalized decimal text|null
